import os,re,json
from collections import deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

def solve(g):
    C=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=C.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cc=comps(g,bg)
    blks=[(c,cells) for c,cells in cc if len(cells)>=4 and len(cells)==(max(p[0] for p in cells)-min(p[0] for p in cells)+1)*(max(p[1] for p in cells)-min(p[1] for p in cells)+1)]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for c,cells in cc:
        if (c,cells) in [(b[0],b[1]) for b in blks]: continue
        inside=False
        for _,bs in blks:
            y0=min(p[0] for p in bs);y1=max(p[0] for p in bs);x0=min(p[1] for p in bs);x1=max(p[1] for p in bs)

        tgt=c if inside else bg
        for (y,x) in cells: out[y][x]=tgt
    return out

from collections import deque,Counter
def comps2(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if seen[y][x] or g[y][x]==bg: continue
            col=g[y][x]; dq=deque([(y,x)]);seen[y][x]=True;cells=set()
            while dq:
                cy,cx=dq.popleft();cells.add((cy,cx))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=cy+dy,cx+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==col:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True;dq.append((ny,nx))
            ys=[p[0] for p in cells];xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
            hgt=max(ys)-min(ys)+1;wid=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
            isrect = len(cells)==hgt*wid and hgt*wid>=4
            out.append({'c':col,'cells':set(cells),'isrect':isrect})
    return out
def solveF(g, thr_area=4):
    C=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=C.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cc=comps2(g,bg)
    # blocks: solid rects with area>=4
    blocks=[(c,cells,(min(p[0] for p in cells),max(p[0] for p in cells),min(p[1] for p in cells),max(p[1] for p in cells)))
            for c,cells,isrect in cc if isrect]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for bi,b_ in enumerate(cc):
        if b_['isrect']: continue
        cells=b_['cells']
        # find blocks whose bbox contains every cell of the comp
        enc=[bc_ for bc_,cs_,bb in blocks if all(bb[0]<=y<=bb[1] and bb[2]<=x<=bb[3] for y,x in cells)]
        if len(enc)==1:
            tgt=enc[0]
        elif len(enc)>1:
            # pick block by majority of enclosing votes / smallest? use count of comp cells covered depth
            cnt={}
            for bc_,cs_,bb in blocks:
                d=sum(1 for y,x in cells if bb[0]<=y<=bb[1] and bb[2]<=x<=bb[3])
                if d: cnt[bc_]=d
            tgt=max(cnt,key=lambda k:cnt[k])
        else:
            tgt=bg
        for (y,x) in cells: out[y][x]=tgt
    return out
for i in range(1,9):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%i]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%i]
    m=solveF(gi)
    nd=sum(1 for y in range(len(gi)) for x in range(len(gi[0])) if m[y][x]!=go[y][x])
    print('demo',i,'match:',m==go,'ndiff:',nd)

from collections import deque,Counter
def comps2(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]

            if seen[y][x] or g[y][x]==bg: continue
            col=g[y][x]; dq=deque([(y,x)]);seen[y][x]=True;cells=set()
            while dq:
                cy,cx=dq.popleft();cells.add((cy,cx))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=cy+dy,cx+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==col:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True;dq.append((ny,nx))
            ys=[p[0] for p in cells];xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
            hgt=max(ys)-min(ys)+1;wid=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
            isrect = len(cells)==hgt*wid and hgt*wid>=4
